title: task.completed@1
description: An agent marked a task of its own completed (Claude Code's TaskCompleted). It is the agent's word, held at the child gate until its checks pass; it never closes the task, which only a verdict does (task.closed).

subject.description: The session that marked the task completed: a lead or a child.

writer.description: Only the hook appends this kind: an adapter maps its agent's events from hook payloads.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

agent_task.description: The task's ID in the agent's own task list.

title.description: The task's subject, as the agent wrote it.
